description: Fetch and parse a dataset's best CSV/JSON/GeoJSON resource (or a direct resource_url) and return its row count and, per column, the detected type (number/string/mixed), non-null count and example values; use it to plan query_dataset filters or aggregate_dataset group-bys. Examples: {id: '<dataset-id>'} or {id: '<dataset-id>', portal: 'stadt-zuerich', resource: '1'}.

format.description: Preferred resource format (overrides the CSV-first default)

id.description: Dataset ID (slug): the 'id' of a search_datasets hit

lang.description: Language for titles/descriptions: de, fr, it or en (default en; falls back to de)

portal.description: Catalogue: 'opendata.swiss' (default, national), 'stadt-zuerich' (City of Zürich, data.stadt-zuerich.ch) or 'envidat' (WSL/ETH environmental research data: snow, glaciers, forests, biodiversity, climate)

resource.description: Optional resource selector: 0-based index from get_dataset, resource id, or part of its title. Default: best CSV > JSON > GeoJSON

resource_url.description: Alternatively, a direct https URL of a CSV/JSON/GeoJSON file (e.g. a download_url from get_dataset). May be disabled on public deployments, prefer 'id'

name: describe_dataset_columns
title: Profile the columns of an open-data dataset
